title: Waverly Place Collection 2 Swing Arm Towel Rail, 12.5-Inch, Solid Brass, Wall Mount, Allied Brass
body_html:
Keep towels separated and within reach—then swing them back to the wall when you’re done. This Waverly Place Collection 2 swing arm towel rail uses two independently pivoting arms to add everyday organization in bathrooms where space matters.

  • More usable towel space: Two swing arms keep towels from piling onto a single bar.
  • Adjust on demand: Arms pivot independently so you can position towels where you want them.
  • Clean wall presentation: Concealed screw mounting hardware creates a finished look.
  • Coordinate the room: Designed to pair with the Waverly Place collection—a smart choice for matching Waverly Place and other transitional bath accessories.
  • Built from brass: Crafted from solid brass materials for enduring bathroom use.

Specs & Installation

  • Overall dimensions: 12.5 in L x 7.1 in H x 7 in W
  • Weight capacity: 2 lb
  • Material: Brass
  • Mounting: Wall mount (concealed screw mounting)
  • Included: Towel rail and all installation hardware
  • Assembly required: No
  • Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty
